title: Component
description: Read-only ship component data of a game item, as stable codes, never labels. Present only for a ship component; a material or another item carries none. A key the Basetool does not know for the component is left out. A new value of componentType or itemClass may be added within v1; treat an unknown value as UNKNOWN.

size.description: The component size, shown as S followed by the number.

grade.description: The component grade, usually a single letter such as A.
